title: Creating Yard Locations

children:
You can use this window to create yard locations. This type of location consists of an area and one or 
 several position(s), and are not inventory-tracked. Yard locations are used as a temporary storage area for truck trailers that are going to be received into your warehouse. Once a trailer is residing in a yard location, workers then can move the trailers to other locations in the yard, or move them to the Receiving Dock for processing.
Open the Yard Location Window, and create a new record.

Use the Warehouse 
 Field to indicate where the new location will reside.

Use the 
 Location Area Field to indicate in which area you want to create 
 your new location.
Use the Location Separator Field to view what character will separate the location area and position values when displaying the concatenated value in yard management processing.

Use the Position 
 Range Field to create a single position or a range of positions. Note that you need to have at least 
 one position for every location you create.

If you want 
 to create ONE position, enter the position name in both parts of 
 this field:

If you want 
 to create a RANGE of positions, enter the first position in the 
 range in first field, and the last position in the range in the second 
 field:

Use the Multi Trailer Checkbox to indicate that you can have more than one trailer 
 residing in a particular yard location.

Right-click the record 
 of a position you want to delete, and select 
 the Delete Action. The system will display the record in the Yard Location 
 Window.

Use the Position Range Field 
 to indicate which position(s) you want to delete:

If you want 
 to delete ONE position, enter the position name in both parts of 
 this field.

If you want 
 to delete a RANGE of positions, enter the first position in the 
 range in first field, and the last position in the range in the second 
 field.

Press OK. 
 The system will prompt you to confirm that you want to delete these positions. 
 Press OK again, and the system will perform the delete action.
